items.markingKey: Revenue = S × P (column of selling prices) = [8800; 10040] (2 marks); profit = S × (P − C) = [1830; 1920] (2 marks); statement (1 mark).

items.stem:
Assertion (A): The system 2x + 3y = 6, 6x + 9y = 18 is consistent.
Reason (R): The two equations represent the same line.
Choose the correct option.
items.answer: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
items.markingKey: (a) Infinitely many solutions.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

items.stem: Find the adjoint of the matrix A = [−2, 1; 7, −5].
items.markingKey: For [a, b; c, d], adj = [d, −b; −c, a].

items.stem: Using determinants, examine the consistency of 5x + 6y = 11, 20x + 24y = 49.
items.markingKey: D = 5(24) − 6(20) = 0 and D₁ = −30 ≠ 0, so no solution.

items.stem: Sahil's school canteen sells samosas at ₹x and juice at ₹y. One group buys 4 samosas and 5 juices for ₹496; another buys 6 samosas and 2 juices for ₹546. (i) Write the system of equations. (ii) Find D. (iii) Find x and y by Cramer's rule.
items.markingKey: (i) 1 mark (ii) 1 mark (iii) D₁, D₂ and the quotients (2 marks).
(AB)ᵢⱼ = Σ aᵢₖbₖⱼ (row of A times column of B): AB = [2, 0, 8; 0, 0, 0].
